title: The Carryover Addition on a Standing Automatic Payment for an Account Running Late
content:
A carryover addition covers the recurring cost of a card account under Personal Credit Cards that has been running late. It is read from the late payment fees billed to that card account and the interest billed to it.

| Late payment fees billed in the last six months | Interest billed in the last six months | Carryover addition |
|---|---|---|
| at least 1 | at least 300.00 USD | 45.00 USD |
| at least 1 | less than 300.00 USD | 20.00 USD |
| none | any | none |

In words: where at least 1 late payment fee has been billed to the card account in the last six months and the interest billed to it in the last six months totals at least 300.00 USD, the carryover addition is 45.00 USD. Where at least 1 late payment fee has been billed in that window and that interest totals less than 300.00 USD, the carryover addition is 20.00 USD. Where no late payment fee has been billed to the card account in the last six months, no carryover addition is made.

**On the boundaries.** The fee count is read as at least, so a single late payment fee in the last six months is enough to reach the first two rows, and none at all settles the matter without the interest being reached. The interest figure separates at exactly 300.00 USD, which belongs with the higher addition; interest of 299.99 USD in the window takes 20.00 USD.
